text:
Marie (People Ops): Heads-up — Lucas's birthday is next Wed. Quick poll: desk plant vs confetti/noisemaker vs just a virtual card? Also thinking a tiny in-office parade (5-min, sax + silly hats) at 3pm for anyone onsite. Thoughts? :balloon: :tada:
Jenna: Plant please! low waste and lasts longer. :seedling:
Tom: Noisemaker is hilarious — I volunteer to bring the kazoo/noisemaker stash. Also can I DJ a short sax playlist? :saxophone: :grin:
Priya: Can we do both? plant for desk + a 5-min parade for folks in office. Remote folks get a care package or a virtual card so they aren't left out.
Alex: +1 plant. If it's small and chill, I'm in. Also propose a 'quiet fun' option: donut + card at Lucas's desk (no bells).
Lucas O: you really don't have to go big — plant sounds lovely though :) thanks everyone! :heart:
Marie (People Ops): sweet — I'm creating a tiny poll. Please react to this thread: :one: = plant, :two: = noisemaker/parade, :three: = donut/card (quiet), :four: = plant + parade. I'll also add a calendar invite for people who want to join at 3pm. RSVP there.
BirthdayBot: Poll created. React with :one:, :two:, :three:, or :four:. Reminder will go out 24h before event.
Jenna: reacted with :one: :white_check_mark:
Tom: reacted with :two: :laughing:
Priya: reacted with :four: :party_popper:
Alex: reacted with :one: :donut:
Marie (People Ops): Noted — leaning plant + small optional parade. I'll order a medium snake plant and a tiny paper hat supply. Remote care-package option for folks who want it — fill this quick form: https://forms.redwood.dev/bday-care (or reply here).
Lucas O: omg the paper hats. I'll wear one if you insist. :sweat_smile:
Marie (People Ops): Thanks all — will post final plan Monday and send calendar invite for the 3pm mini-parade. If anyone wants to chip in $5 for the plant upgrade or cards, DM me.
